therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Omega-3 fatty acid supplementation to modulate inflammatory pathways and prostaglandin production
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reduction of epithelial cell proliferation and modulation of apoptosis in colorectal tissue
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Rectal epithelial cell proliferation (Ki67 labeling) and apoptosis (TUNEL assay)

results.effect_size: Variable effects by rs174535 genotype - proliferation and apoptosis changes not consistently favorable
results.target_engagement_evidence: Demonstrated changes in rectal epithelial cell phospholipid fatty acid content and PGE2/PGE3 production
biomarker_changes: PGE2 reduced in all genotype groups with fish oil vs placebo
COX-2 expression showed mixed results by genotype
subgroup_findings: rs174535 TT genotype showed greatest proliferation reduction with fish oil (15.7% vs 20.8% placebo)
rs174535 GT genotype showed greatest apoptosis increase with placebo (2.61% vs 1.00% fish oil)
Adiponectin levels increased most in TT genotype with fish oil (29.4 vs 15.3 ng/mL)
safety_signals: One myocardial infarction in placebo group (rs174535 GG genotype)
results.dose_information: 1395 mg EPA plus 1125 mg DHA daily for 24 weeks
